crossRefs.note: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,
preaching God’s Kingdom, and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

people.name: Rome

translations.web: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me
translations.bsb: Indeed, when he arrived in Rome, he searched diligently until he found me.
translations.kjv: But, when he was in Rome, he sought ➔ me out very diligently, and found me.
